teaser.en: On the Shimba Hills grasslands, this tall grass turns red-brown in the dry season and has long been cut for roofs.
teaser.sw: Katika nyika za Shimba Hills, nyasi hii ndefu hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu wakati wa kiangazi na tangu zamani imekuwa ikikatwa kwa ajili ya kuezekea paa.
teaser.dg: Kpwenye herera za Shimba Hills, nyasi hino ndefu inakala ya rangi ya dongo ya kundu wakati wa kazikazi, na hangu kare nkukatwa kpwa kuezekera nyumba.

summary.en: *Mdembe* is a tall thatching grass of the Shimba Hills and coastal grassland. Its drooping, bristly heads turn red-brown as it dries.
summary.sw: *Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu ya kuezekea ya Shimba Hills na nyika za pwani. Vishada vyake vinavyoinama, vyenye nywele ngumu, hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu inapokauka.
summary.dg: *Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu ya kuezekera ya Shimba Hills na ya herera za pwani. Vitswavye vinavyobwadzika, vyenye nyere ndefu, vinakala vya rangi ya dongo ya kundu ichiuma.

about.en:
*Mdembe* is a tall, tufted grass that can stand well above head height. Its flowering heads droop, and each spikelet carries a long, twisted bristle (an awn), giving the heads a wispy look.

As the dry season comes, the whole plant turns red-brown.
about.sw:
*Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu inayoota kwa vichaka, inayoweza kusimama juu zaidi ya kimo cha mtu. Vishada vyake vya maua huinama, na kila kichanua kina unywele mrefu mgumu uliojisokota, na kuvipa vishada sura nyepesi kama nywele.

Kiangazi kinapoingia, mmea mzima hugeuka kahawia-nyekundu.
about.dg:
*Mdembe* ni nyasi ndefu inayomera mabunda, inayoweza kuima dzulu kuriko chitswa cha mutu. Vitswavye vya maruwa vinabwadzika, na chila chitembe dide china nyere ndefu iriyosokotwa (*awn* kpwa Chingereza), kpwa hivyo vitswa vinaonekana dza nyuzi-nyuzi.

Wakati wa kazikazi uchifika, mmea wosi unakala wa rangi ya dongo ya kundu.

where.en: Look for *mdembe* in the Shimba Hills and in other coastal grassland. The red-brown stands are most striking in the dry season.
where.sw: Itafute *mdembe* katika Shimba Hills na katika nyika nyingine za pwani. Vichaka vyake vya kahawia-nyekundu huvutia zaidi wakati wa kiangazi.
where.dg: Hendza *mdembe* Shimba Hills na kpwenye herera zanjina za pwani. Mabunda ga rangi ya dongo ya kundu ganaonekana zaidi wakati wa kazikazi.

names.en: Digo: *mdembe*. The same name is also given as an alternative for *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), another thatching grass. English: thatching grass. No Swahili name has been recorded. Scientists call it *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdembe*. Jina hili pia hutolewa kama jina mbadala la *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea. Kwa Kiingereza: *thatching grass*. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa. Wanasayansi huiita *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mdembe*. Dzina hiri piya rinaandikpwa dza dzina ranjina ra *mchuchi* (*Hyparrhenia*), nyasi yanjina ya kuezekera. Kpwa Chingereza ni *thatching grass*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Hyperthelia dissoluta*.

reason.en: Another thatching grass that shares the name mdembe
reason.sw: Nyasi nyingine ya kuezekea inayoshiriki jina mdembe
reason.dg: Nyasi yanjina ya kuezekera inayoihwa piya *mdembe*

reason.en: Tall grass of the same grassland
reason.sw: Nyasi ndefu ya nyika zile zile
reason.dg: Nyasi ndefu ya herera iyo iyo
